title: Rexo repository configuration schema
description: Schema for repo.json, the main Rexo repository runtime configuration file.
markdownDescription: Schema for `repo.json`, the main Rexo repository runtime configuration file.

$schema.description: Schema URI/path used by editors and validation. Use the canonical remote URL for shared repositories.
$schema.markdownDescription: Schema URI/path used by editors and validation. Use the canonical remote URL for shared repositories.

schemaVersion.description: Schema contract version for this config file. Currently only 1.0 is supported.
schemaVersion.markdownDescription: Schema contract version for this config file. Currently only `1.0` is supported.

name.description: Human-friendly repository/runtime name shown in command output.
name.markdownDescription: Human-friendly repository/runtime name shown in command output.

description.description: Optional longer description of the repository runtime.
description.markdownDescription: Optional longer description of the repository runtime. Leave it out if you do not need a human-readable summary.

version.description: Optional static version string. Most repositories should prefer the versioning section instead.
version.markdownDescription: Optional static version string. Most repositories should prefer the `versioning` section instead.

extends.description: List of config sources to merge into this config before applying local values. Supports embedded lifecycle policies via the 'embedded:' URI scheme (e.g. 'embedded:standard', 'embedded:dotnet') and local file paths. Embedded policies provide shared lifecycle commands (build, test, verify, release, plan, push, etc.). Use 'rx policies list' to see available embedded policies.
extends.markdownDescription: List of config sources to merge into this config before applying local values. Supports embedded lifecycle policies via the `embedded:` URI scheme (for example `embedded:standard` and `embedded:dotnet`) and local file paths. Embedded policies provide shared lifecycle commands such as build, test, verify, release, plan, and push. Use `rx policies list` to see available embedded policies.

policySources.description: Policy-only sources loaded and merged into the effective config before the local policy.json and REXO_POLICY_SOURCES env-var sources. Each entry supports the same source types as REXO_POLICY_SOURCES: HTTPS URL (optionally with #sha256=<hex> pin), git+ reference (git+<repo>@<ref>#<path>), nuget: reference (nuget:<id>@<version>#<path>), or a local file path. REXO_POLICY_SOURCES always wins over config-declared sources. Use this for opt-in team policies that should be version-controlled alongside the repo.
policySources.markdownDescription: Policy-only sources loaded and merged into the effective config before the local `policy.json` and `REXO_POLICY_SOURCES` env-var sources. Each entry supports the same source types as `REXO_POLICY_SOURCES`: HTTPS URLs (optionally with a `#sha256=<hex>` pin), `git+` references, `nuget:` references, or local file paths. `REXO_POLICY_SOURCES` always wins over config-declared sources. Use this for opt-in team policies that should be version-controlled alongside the repo.

commands.description: Command map exposed by rx. Keys are command names and values define arguments, options, and steps.
commands.markdownDescription: Command map exposed by `rx`. See [Commands, Options, and Steps](docs/configuration/commands.md) for hooks, merge behavior, option typing, and step composition.

aliases.description: Simple command aliases. Key is alias name, value is the target command string.
aliases.markdownDescription: Simple command aliases. The key is the alias name and the value is the target command string. Aliases resolve before command execution and can target hidden commands.

versioning.description: Version provider configuration used by builtin:resolve-version.
versioning.markdownDescription: Version provider configuration used by `builtin:resolve-version`. See [Versioning Configuration](docs/configuration/versioning.md). When omitted, `auto` will choose `nbgv`, `gitversion`, `minver`, `git`, or `fixed` from repository evidence and fall back to `0.1.0-local`.

artifacts.description: Artifact definitions used by builtin:build-artifacts, builtin:tag-artifacts, and builtin:push-artifacts.
artifacts.markdownDescription: Artifact definitions used by `builtin:build-artifacts`, `builtin:tag-artifacts`, and `builtin:push-artifacts`. See [Artifact Providers](docs/artifacts/README.md) for the provider index and provider-specific settings.

runtime.description: Cross-cutting runtime policy configuration for output and push behavior.
runtime.markdownDescription: Cross-cutting runtime policy configuration for output, push, and command delegation. See [Runtime Configuration](docs/configuration/runtime.md). This is where global defaults such as dry-run, push gating, and same-name command collision behavior live.

outputs.description: Output path contract. Resolved paths are available as {{outputs.*}} in policy command templates.
outputs.markdownDescription: Output path contract for manifests, CI emission, logs, test output, and package folders. See [Output Contract](docs/configuration/output-contract.md) and [CI Output Emission](docs/configuration/ci-output-emission.md). Omitted values resolve under `outputs.root`, which defaults to `artifacts`.

settings.description: Toolchain-specific settings available as {{settings.*}} in policy command templates.
settings.markdownDescription: Toolchain-specific settings available as `{{settings.*}}` in policy command templates. Use this for repository- or policy-specific knobs that do not belong in the core schema.

vars.description: Free-form template variable bag. All values are accessible as {{vars.*}} in step run strings and support arbitrary nesting (e.g. {{vars.dotnet.solution}}).
vars.markdownDescription: Free-form template variable bag available as `{{vars.*}}` in step `run` strings. See [Template Variables](docs/configuration/templates.md) for rendering rules and filter support.

secrets.description: First-class secret configuration for runtime resolution and template access under {{secrets.*}}.
secrets.markdownDescription: First-class secret resolution configuration. See [Secrets](docs/configuration/secrets.md). Use `defaults` for shared provider behavior, `providers` for reusable provider definitions, and `items` for named secrets exposed as `{{secrets.<name>}}`.

capabilities.description: Runtime capability requirements and compatibility contract expectations.
capabilities.markdownDescription: Runtime capability requirements and compatibility expectations. Use this to declare which features the active runtime must support before the config is considered compatible.

settings.description: Free-form toolchain settings bag available as {{settings.*}} in templates.
settings.markdownDescription: Free-form toolchain settings bag available as `{{settings.*}}` in templates. Omit it to keep an empty settings map; runtime behavior stays unchanged.

vars.description: Free-form template variable bag. Accessible as {{vars.*}} in step run strings. Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, or arbitrarily nested objects.
vars.markdownDescription: Free-form template variable bag available as `{{vars.*}}` in step `run` strings. Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, or arbitrarily nested objects, and missing entries simply render empty.

secretCacheConfig.markdownDescription: Per-command in-memory cache for secret resolution. `enabled` toggles the cache and `ttlSeconds` sets the cache TTL in seconds.

enabled.description: Enable per-command in-memory cache for the secret or provider.

secretDefaultsConfig.markdownDescription:
Shared defaults for named secrets. See [Secrets](docs/configuration/secrets.md).

- `provider`: default provider type when a secret item does not specify one.
- `providerChain`: ordered provider candidates evaluated before the default provider.
- `fallbackToEnvironment`: default `true`; fall back to environment lookup after providers fail.
- `stopOnFirstError`: stop on the first provider failure instead of trying the next candidate.
- `cache`: per-command in-memory cache settings.
- `required`: default required/optional behavior for secret items.

provider.description: Default secret provider type (for example env, 1password, exec).

providerChain.description: Ordered provider candidates evaluated at runtime until one resolves the secret.

fallbackToEnvironment.description: When true (default), fall back to environment lookup after configured providers fail.

stopOnFirstError.description: When true, stop the chain on the first provider error instead of falling back to the next candidate.

required.description: Default required behavior for secret entries.

secretProviderConfig.markdownDescription: Reusable secret provider definition. `type` selects the implementation; `auth` and `settings` are provider-specific; `cache` can override the default cache behavior for that provider.

auth.description: Provider auth values or references interpreted by the provider implementation.

secretProviderRouteConfig.markdownDescription: One candidate in a secret provider chain. `runtime` can be `local`, `ci`, or a CI provider name; `selector` and `env` can be overridden per route.

providerRef.description: Reference to a named provider declared under secrets.providers.

env.description: Environment variable override for this route.

runtime.description: Runtime filter for the candidate. Use local, ci, or a CI provider name such as github-actions.

secretItemConfig.markdownDescription: Named secret item exposed as `{{secrets.<name>}}`. Item-level values override `secrets.defaults`; `fallbackToEnvironment` and `stopOnFirstError` control resolution fallback; `required` secrets fail preflight when unresolved; `exposeInTemplates` controls template visibility; `mapToEnv` and `mapToEnvs` inject runtime environment variables.

providerRef.description: Reference to a named provider declared under secrets.providers.

providerChain.description: Ordered provider candidates evaluated at runtime until one resolves the secret.

fallbackToEnvironment.description: When true (default), fall back to environment lookup after configured providers fail.

stopOnFirstError.description: When true, stop the chain on the first provider error instead of falling back to the next candidate.

selector.description: Provider selector/key/path used to resolve the secret.

env.description: Environment variable name used by env provider.

required.description: When true (default), missing secret fails command execution.

exposeInTemplates.description: When true (default), expose resolved value in templates under secrets.*.

mapToEnv.description: Optional environment variable name to inject the resolved secret into at runtime.

mapToEnvs.description: Optional additional environment variable names to inject the resolved secret into at runtime.

secretsConfig.markdownDescription: Secret configuration root. See [Secrets](docs/configuration/secrets.md). Use `defaults` for shared secret resolution behavior, `providers` for reusable providers, and `items` for named secrets exposed as `{{secrets.<name>}}`. Omit the section entirely when the repo only needs ambient environment-based secret lookup.

capabilityContract.description: Declares compatibility against runtime capability contract and required features.
capabilityContract.markdownDescription: Declares compatibility against the runtime capability contract and required features. This is a lightweight declaration of what the config expects the active runtime to support.

contractVersion.description: Capability contract version expected by this config. Current runtime contract is 1.0.
contractVersion.markdownDescription: Capability contract version expected by this config. Current runtime contract is `1.0`.

required.description: Capabilities that must be supported by the active runtime.
required.markdownDescription: Capabilities that must be supported by the active runtime.

repoCommand.description: Reusable command definition for both repository and policy commands.
repoCommand.markdownDescription: Reusable command definition for both repository and policy commands. See [Commands, Options, and Steps](docs/configuration/commands.md). Use this shape for both repo-local commands and policy-provided commands. `steps` is required; `hidden` only affects discovery; `before` and `after` wrap the main pipeline; `merge` and `stepOps` control composition across `extends`; `maxDepth` falls back to the runtime default when omitted.

description.description: Human-readable command summary used in help/list output.

args.description: Positional argument declarations keyed by argument name.

options.description: Named option declarations keyed by option name.

steps.description: Ordered execution steps that implement the command.

hidden.description: When true, omit this command from default discovery surfaces like list/help while keeping it callable by name.

before.description: Optional hook executed before this command's steps. Supports a command name string or an explicit step array.

after.description: Optional hook executed after this command's steps. Supports a command name string or an explicit step array.

maxParallel.description: Maximum concurrent step execution when parallel groups are used.

maxDepth.description: Maximum delegated command call depth for this command chain.

merge.description: Layered command composition behavior. Accepts legacy string mode or merge envelope object.

stepOps.description: Legacy explicit step-level extension operations. Prefer merge.steps envelope.

commandMerge.description: Command merge configuration. Can be a legacy scalar mode or envelope object.
commandMerge.markdownDescription: Command merge configuration used when commands are combined through `extends` or policy overlays. See [Commands, Options, and Steps](docs/configuration/commands.md). Legacy scalar modes remain supported, but the merge envelope is preferred when you need both composition mode and explicit step operations.

commandHook.description: Command hook input. Accepts either a command name string or a list of explicit steps.
commandHook.markdownDescription: Command hook input for `before` and `after`. Accepts either a command name string or an explicit step array.

commandMergeMode.description: Layered command composition mode for this command.
commandMergeMode.markdownDescription: Layered command composition mode for a command. `append` and `prepend` are additive; `replace` swaps the base command; `wrap` surrounds it; `layer` keeps the base command as the primary behavior.

commandMergeEnvelope.description: Unified merge envelope containing mode and optional step operations.
commandMergeEnvelope.markdownDescription: Unified merge envelope containing `mode` and optional `steps` operations.

commandStepOps.markdownDescription: Legacy explicit step-level extension operations. Prefer `merge.steps` when authoring new configs; this block remains for compatibility with older overlays.

remove.description: Step ids to remove from the inherited command pipeline.

prepend.description: Steps inserted before the inherited pipeline.

append.description: Steps added after the inherited pipeline.

argConfig.description: Configuration for a positional command argument.
argConfig.markdownDescription: Configuration for a positional command argument. Set `required` to `true` when callers must provide the positional value.

required.description: Whether this positional argument must be supplied by the caller.

description.description: Help text shown for the argument.

optionConfig.description: Configuration for a named command option.
optionConfig.markdownDescription: Configuration for a named command option. `type` defaults to `string`; `default` is used only when the caller does not supply the option; `allowed` constrains runtime values.

default.description: Default value used when the caller does not provide this option.

allowed.description: Optional allowed values list enforced at runtime.

step.description: Single executable unit in a command pipeline. Exactly one of run, uses, or command must be set.
step.markdownDescription: Single executable unit in a command pipeline. Exactly one of `run`, `uses`, or `command` must be set. See [Commands, Options, and Steps](docs/configuration/commands.md) and [Containerized Run Steps](docs/configuration/containerized-run.md). `run` steps render templates first; `command` steps forward into another config command; `uses` steps invoke built-ins.

id.description: Stable step identifier for logging, dependency wiring, and output references.

command.description: Invokes another configured command by name.

uses.description: Invokes a built-in primitive (for example builtin:resolve-version).

container.description: Optional run-step container wrapper. When set, the rendered run command executes inside the specified container image.
container.markdownDescription: Optional Docker wrapper for `run` steps. See [Containerized Run Steps](docs/configuration/containerized-run.md). `image` is required; `workingDirectory` defaults to `/work`; `dockerfile` and `context` let Rexo build the image when needed.

image.description: Container image used to execute the run command.

env.description: Additional environment variables injected into the container process.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory inside the container. Defaults to /work.

entrypoint.description: Optional container entrypoint override passed to docker run --entrypoint.

dockerfile.description: Optional Dockerfile path used to build container.image when missing or stale. Relative paths are resolved from repository root.

context.description: Optional docker build context directory used with container.dockerfile. Defaults to repository root.

build.description: Optional docker build options used when container.dockerfile is configured.

target.description: Optional docker build target stage passed as --target.

args.description: Optional docker build arguments passed as --build-arg key=value.

when.description: Conditional expression that controls whether the step runs.

with.description: String key/value inputs passed to the selected built-in or command.

description.description: Optional step summary shown in plan/log output.

whenExists.description: Only for command steps. When true, missing target commands are skipped successfully instead of failing.

continueOnError.description: Continue executing subsequent steps when this step fails.

parallel.description: Marks the step as eligible for parallel scheduling with other independent steps.

dependsOn.description: List of step ids that must complete before this step executes.

outputPattern.description: Regex pattern used by compatible steps to capture structured output values.
outputPattern.markdownDescription: Regex pattern used by compatible steps to capture structured output values. Named capture groups become step outputs.

outputFile.description: Path to an output file consumed by compatible steps for captured outputs.
outputFile.markdownDescription: Path to an output file consumed by compatible steps for captured outputs. The path is template-rendered before use, so it can reference step, version, args, options, and outputs values.

outputs.description: Step output declarations. Each key names an output category; values are arrays of glob patterns relative to the repository root that identify produced files.
outputs.markdownDescription: Step output declarations. Each key names an output category; values are arrays of glob patterns relative to the repository root that identify produced files. Use this when a step produces files instead of inline text outputs.

versioning.markdownDescription:
Version provider configuration used by `builtin:resolve-version`. See [Versioning Configuration](docs/configuration/versioning.md).

- `provider`: chooses how Rexo resolves the version. Omit it to use `auto`.
- `fallback`: version string used when resolution fails or is unavailable.
- `settings`: provider-specific knobs such as `variable`, `tagPrefix`, or `minimumMajorMinor`.

For `gitversion`, `nbgv`, and `minver`, Docker fallback is enabled by default and `dockerImage` is template-rendered before use.

provider.description: Version provider to use. 'auto' (default) detects the right provider from config file evidence: version.json/nbgv.json → nbgv; GitVersion.yml → gitversion; .minverrc → minver; .git present → git; otherwise → fixed.
provider.markdownDescription: Version provider to use. `auto` is the default and scans for `version.json`/`nbgv.json`, `GitVersion.yml`, `.minverrc`, or `.git` before falling back to `fixed`.

fallback.description: Version string used when the provider cannot resolve a version (e.g. no tags yet).
fallback.markdownDescription: Version string used when the provider cannot resolve a version. Default: `0.1.0-local`.

settings.description: Provider-specific settings. Common keys: variable (env), tagPrefix/minimumMajorMinor (minver). Docker fallback keys (all providers except fixed/env/git): useDocker (default true — set false to disable), dockerImage (override the default Docker image).
settings.markdownDescription: Provider-specific settings. Common keys include `variable` for `env`, `tagPrefix` and `minimumMajorMinor` for `minver`, and Docker fallback settings for `gitversion`/`nbgv`/`minver`. `useDocker` defaults to `true` for those providers, and `dockerImage` overrides the fallback container image.

artifact.description: Artifact declaration. Choose docker, nuget, helm-oci, npm, pypi, maven, gradle, rubygems, terraform, helm, docker-compose, or a custom provider type.
artifact.markdownDescription: Artifact declaration. See [Artifact Providers](docs/artifacts/README.md). Choose one provider-specific shape per entry; omit the array entirely when the repo does not build or publish artifacts.

dockerArtifact.markdownDescription: Docker image artifact configuration. See [docker.md](docs/artifacts/docker.md). Use this when the repository builds or ships a container image; omit `settings` to keep provider defaults.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests. When omitted, falls back to the root config name.

settings.description: Provider-specific docker build, tag, and push settings.

nugetArtifact.markdownDescription: NuGet package artifact configuration. See [nuget.md](docs/artifacts/nuget.md). Use this when the repository packs and optionally publishes NuGet packages.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests. When omitted, falls back to the root config name.

genericArtifact.description: Fallback artifact shape for custom providers not explicitly modeled in this schema.
genericArtifact.markdownDescription: Fallback artifact shape for custom providers not explicitly modeled in this schema. See [generic.md](docs/artifacts/generic.md). Use this when you need arbitrary provider settings or a custom artifact type.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests. When omitted, falls back to the root config name.

settings.description: Provider-specific arbitrary settings for custom artifact providers.

helmOciArtifact.description: Helm chart artifact pushed to OCI registry.
helmOciArtifact.markdownDescription: Helm chart artifact pushed to OCI registry. See [helm-oci.md](docs/artifacts/helm-oci.md). Use this when chart packaging should target an OCI destination.

type.description: Selects the Helm OCI artifact provider.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests. When omitted, falls back to the root config name.

settings.description: Provider-specific Helm package and OCI push settings.

npmArtifact.markdownDescription: npm package artifact configuration. See [npm.md](docs/artifacts/npm.md). Use this when the repository packs and publishes npm packages.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests.

directory.description: Working directory containing package.json. Defaults to repo root.

target.description: Target settings for npm publish endpoint and credential env-name overrides.

registryEnv.description: Environment variable name containing target npm registry URL. Defaults to NPM_TARGET_REGISTRY.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable name containing npm auth token. Defaults to NPM_TOKEN.

tag.description: Distribution tag to publish under. Defaults to version.

useDocker.description: Use a Docker container as a fallback runtime when npm is not installed on the host. Defaults to true.

dockerImage.description: Docker image used when falling back to the containerized npm runtime. Defaults to node:lts-alpine.

extra-build-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to the npm pack command.

extra-push-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to the npm publish command.

pypiArtifact.markdownDescription: Python/PyPI package artifact configuration. See [pypi.md](docs/artifacts/pypi.md). Use this when the repository builds and publishes Python distributions.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests.

directory.description: Working directory. Defaults to repo root.

target.description: Target settings for twine endpoint and credential env-name overrides.

repositoryUrl.description: PyPI repository URL for twine upload.

repositoryUrlEnv.description: Environment variable name containing repository URL. Defaults to PYPI_TARGET_REPOSITORY_URL.

apiTokenEnv.description: Environment variable name containing API token. Defaults to TWINE_API_TOKEN.

usernameEnv.description: Environment variable name containing username. Defaults to TWINE_USERNAME.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable name containing password. Defaults to TWINE_PASSWORD.

useDocker.description: Use a Docker container as a fallback runtime when python/python3 is not installed on the host. Defaults to true.

dockerImage.description: Docker image used when falling back to the containerized Python runtime. Defaults to python:3-slim. The default image does not include build or twine — provide a custom image if needed.

extra-build-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to the python -m build command.

extra-push-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to the python -m twine upload command.

mavenArtifact.markdownDescription: Maven package/deploy artifact configuration. See [maven.md](docs/artifacts/maven.md). Use this when the repository packages or deploys Maven artifacts.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests.

project.description: Path to the pom.xml file. Defaults to root pom.xml.

target.description: Target credential env-name overrides for Maven publishing.

usernameEnv.description: Environment variable name containing Maven username. Defaults to MAVEN_REPO_USERNAME.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable name containing Maven password/token. Defaults to MAVEN_REPO_PASSWORD.

useDocker.description: Use a Docker container as a fallback runtime when mvn is not installed on the host. Defaults to true.

dockerImage.description: Docker image used when falling back to the containerized Maven runtime. Defaults to maven:3-eclipse-temurin-21.

extra-build-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to mvn package.

extra-push-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to mvn deploy.

gradleArtifact.markdownDescription: Gradle build/publish artifact configuration. See [gradle.md](docs/artifacts/gradle.md). Use this when the repository builds or publishes through Gradle.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests.

tasks.description: Gradle tasks to run for build. Defaults to 'build'.

wrapper.description: Use Gradle wrapper (gradlew) if present. Defaults to true.

directory.description: Working directory containing build.gradle. Defaults to repo root.

target.description: Target credential env-name overrides for Gradle publish flows.

usernameEnv.description: Environment variable name containing Maven publish username. Defaults to ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_mavenUsername.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable name containing Maven publish password. Defaults to ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_mavenPassword.

publishKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name containing Gradle Plugin Portal publish key. Defaults to GRADLE_PUBLISH_KEY.

publishSecretEnv.description: Environment variable name containing Gradle Plugin Portal publish secret. Defaults to GRADLE_PUBLISH_SECRET.

useDocker.description: Use a Docker container as a fallback runtime when gradle is not installed on the host. Defaults to true.

dockerImage.description: Docker image used when falling back to the containerized Gradle runtime. Defaults to gradle:8-jdk21.

extra-build-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to the Gradle build task(s).

extra-push-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to the Gradle publish task.

rubygemsArtifact.markdownDescription: RubyGems gem build/push artifact configuration. See [rubygems.md](docs/artifacts/rubygems.md). Use this when the repository builds and publishes Ruby gems.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests.

gemspec.description: Path or glob to the .gemspec file. Defaults to '*.gemspec'.

target.description: Target settings for RubyGems source and credential env-name overrides.

source.description: Gem server source URL for gem push.

sourceEnv.description: Environment variable name containing target source URL. Defaults to RUBYGEMS_TARGET_SOURCE.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name containing API key/token. Defaults to GEM_HOST_API_KEY.

gem-pattern.description: Glob pattern for the built gem file to push. Defaults to '*.gem'.

directory.description: Working directory. Defaults to repo root.

useDocker.description: Use a Docker container as a fallback runtime when gem is not installed on the host. Defaults to true.

dockerImage.description: Docker image used when falling back to the containerized Ruby runtime. Defaults to ruby:3-alpine.

extra-build-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to gem build.

extra-push-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to gem push.

terraformArtifact.markdownDescription: Terraform plan/apply artifact configuration. See [terraform.md](docs/artifacts/terraform.md). Use this when the repository packages and applies Terraform modules or plans.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests.

directory.description: Directory containing Terraform configuration. Defaults to '.'.

target.description: Target settings for Terraform workspace and var-file env overrides.

workspace.description: Terraform workspace to select before apply.

workspaceEnv.description: Environment variable name containing Terraform workspace. Defaults to TERRAFORM_TARGET_WORKSPACE.

varFile.description: Path to a .tfvars file to pass to terraform plan.

varFileEnv.description: Environment variable name containing tfvars file path. Defaults to TERRAFORM_TARGET_VAR_FILE.

useDocker.description: Use a Docker container as a fallback runtime when terraform is not installed on the host. Defaults to true.

dockerImage.description: Docker image used when falling back to the containerized Terraform runtime. Defaults to hashicorp/terraform:1.9.

extra-build-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to terraform plan.

extra-push-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to terraform apply.

helmArtifact.markdownDescription: Helm chart package/push artifact configuration (non-OCI). See [helm.md](docs/artifacts/helm.md). Use this when you package charts for a ChartMuseum-style repository or filesystem copy.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests.

chart.description: Path to the chart directory. Defaults to '.'.

chart-directory.description: Path to the chart directory. Defaults to '.'.

output-directory.description: Directory where packaged .tgz files are written. Defaults to repo root.

target.description: Target settings for helm repository endpoint and credential env-name overrides.

repository.description: Chart Museum repo URL (https://…) for helm cm-push, or a local filesystem path for file copy.

repositoryEnv.description: Environment variable name containing target repository. Defaults to HELM_TARGET_REPOSITORY.

usernameEnv.description: Environment variable name containing repository username. Defaults to HELM_REPO_USERNAME.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable name containing repository password/token. Defaults to HELM_REPO_PASSWORD.

useDocker.description: Use a Docker container as a fallback runtime when helm is not installed on the host. Defaults to true.

dockerImage.description: Docker image used when falling back to the containerized Helm runtime. Defaults to alpine/helm:3.17.3.

extra-build-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to helm package.

extra-push-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to helm cm-push.

dockerComposeArtifact.markdownDescription: Docker Compose build/push artifact configuration. See [docker-compose.md](docs/artifacts/docker-compose.md). Use this when the repository builds or pushes compose-defined services.

type.description: Selects the Docker Compose artifact provider.

name.description: Logical artifact name used in logs and manifests.

file.description: Path to the docker-compose file. Defaults to docker-compose.yml.

services.description: Space-separated list of services to build/push. Defaults to all.

target.description: Target settings for compose registry and login env-name overrides.

registry.description: Container registry URL. When set, docker login is performed before push using resolved credentials.

registryEnv.description: Environment variable name containing target registry URL/host. Defaults to DOCKER_COMPOSE_TARGET_REGISTRY.

usernameEnv.description: Environment variable name containing docker login username. Defaults to DOCKER_LOGIN_USERNAME.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable name containing docker login password/token. Defaults to DOCKER_LOGIN_PASSWORD.

loginRegistryEnv.description: Environment variable name containing docker login registry override. Defaults to DOCKER_LOGIN_REGISTRY.

extra-build-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to docker compose build.

extra-push-args.description: Additional space-separated arguments appended to docker compose push.

stringOrStringArray.description: Convenience type that accepts either a single string value or a string array.

tagKindOrTagKindArray.description: One Docker tag strategy kind or a list of tag strategy kinds.

buildArgValue.description: Supported primitive value for a single Docker build argument.

buildArgsValue.description: Accepted forms for Docker build arguments: inline string, key/value object, or list.

secretSpec.description: Docker build secret source. Provide either env or file.

env.description: Environment variable name that contains the secret value.

file.description: Path to a file containing the secret value.

aliasesRule.description: Conditional docker alias tag rule applied to the current branch name.

match.description: Branch match expression (wildcard or regex:... syntax).

template.description: Alias template supporting tokens such as $BRANCH and capture groups like $1.

dockerStage.description: Named multi-stage docker build configuration entry.

output.description: Build output destination(s) for this stage.

runner.description: Docker runner to use for this stage (build, buildx, or auto-detect).

platform.description: Target platform for the stage (for example linux/amd64).

dockerArtifactSettings.description: Detailed docker provider settings covering image naming, build, tagging, aliases, and push behavior.

image.description: Final docker image repository name. If omitted, the artifact name is used.

runner.description: Docker command flavor to use for build operations.

platform.description: Build platform passed to docker via --platform.

buildOutput.description: Build output option(s) passed to docker --output.

registry.description: Legacy shorthand for target registry host. Prefer target.registry.

repository.description: Legacy shorthand for target repository path. Prefer target.repository.

target.description: Target registry/repository destination used to compose the image name.

registry.description: Registry host, for example ghcr.io or myregistry.example.com:5000.

loginRegistry.description: Registry host used for docker login when different from target registry.

login.description: Login override settings for docker authentication.

cleanupLocal.description: Legacy cleanup switch. true/false or auto (auto cleans up in CI). Prefer cleanup.local.

local.description: Controls local image cleanup after build: true, false, or auto.

pushEnabled.description: Legacy push enable flag. Prefer push.enabled.

pushBranches.description: Legacy push branch allow-list. Prefer push.branches.

denyNonPublicPush.description: Legacy switch to prevent pushes from non-public build classifications. Prefer push.denyNonPublicPush.

push.description: Push policy for this docker artifact.

enabled.description: Enables docker push for this artifact.

branches.description: Allowed branch patterns for pushing this artifact.

branchesShortcut.description: Shortcut CSV/string form for branches; merged with push.branches.

denyNonPublicPush.description: Blocks push when build classification resolves to non-public.

latest.description: Legacy switch to emit latest tag. Prefer tags.latest via tag policy settings.

tags.description: Tag strategy names (for example full, majorMinor, major, branch, sha) or a custom list.

publicBuild.description: Legacy explicit build classification as public/non-public. Prefer build.public.

public.description: When set, forces public/non-public build classification.

publicBranches.description: Legacy branch patterns classified as public builds. Prefer classification.publicBranches.

nonPublicBranches.description: Legacy branch patterns classified as non-public builds. Prefer classification.nonPublicBranches.

publicBranches.description: Branch patterns treated as public builds.

nonPublicBranches.description: Branch patterns treated as non-public builds.

tagPolicy.description: Default tag kinds applied by build classification when explicit tags are not set.

nonPublicMode.description: Optional mode override for non-public tagging behavior.

aliases.description: Additional human-friendly alias tags generated from branch names.

branch.description: Emit alias from raw branch name.

sanitizedBranch.description: Emit alias from slug/sanitized branch name.

sanitize.description: Sanitize alias output strings by default.

nonPublicPrefix.description: Prefix used when build classification is non-public.

rules.description: Ordered alias mapping rules; first matching rule is applied.

stages.description: Named build stage definitions for multi-stage Dockerfile workflows.

stageFallback.description: When true, run a final full build after configured stages to produce final tags.

nugetArtifactSettings.description: Settings for dotnet pack and dotnet nuget push operations.

output.description: Package output directory for generated .nupkg files.

target.description: Structured target settings for NuGet push.

source.description: NuGet source/feed URL or name used for push.

sourceEnv.description: Environment variable name containing target source/feed. Defaults to NUGET_TARGET_SOURCE.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name containing API key/token. Defaults to NUGET_API_KEY (fallback alias: NUGET_AUTH_TOKEN).

enabled.description: When true, pushes matching .snupkg files for this artifact.

source.description: Symbol server/feed URL or name used for symbol package push. Defaults to target.source when omitted.

sourceEnv.description: Environment variable name containing symbol target source/feed. Defaults to NUGET_SYMBOL_TARGET_SOURCE.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name containing symbol API key/token. Defaults to NUGET_SYMBOL_API_KEY (fallbacks: NUGET_API_KEY, NUGET_AUTH_TOKEN).

pattern.description: Glob pattern for symbol package files to push (for example artifacts/packages/*.symbols.nupkg). Defaults to <output>/<artifact>.<version>.snupkg.

helmOciArtifactSettings.description: Settings for Helm chart packaging and OCI registry push. Auth env vars: HELM_REGISTRY_USERNAME, HELM_REGISTRY_PASSWORD, HELM_REGISTRY. For ghcr.io, GITHUB_ACTOR+GITHUB_TOKEN are used automatically in GitHub Actions (requires permissions: packages: write).

chart.description: Chart name used to resolve packaged file names. Defaults to artifact name.

chartPath.description: Path to the chart root that contains Chart.yaml.

output.description: Output directory for generated .tgz chart packages.

target.description: Target settings for Helm OCI destination and login env-name overrides.

ociEnv.description: Environment variable name containing full OCI destination. Defaults to HELM_OCI_TARGET.

registry.description: OCI registry host used when composing destination from registry + repository.

registryEnv.description: Environment variable name containing OCI target registry. Defaults to HELM_OCI_TARGET_REGISTRY.

repository.description: OCI repository path used when composing destination from registry + repository.

repositoryEnv.description: Environment variable name containing OCI target repository. Defaults to HELM_OCI_TARGET_REPOSITORY.

loginRegistry.description: Optional registry host to use for helm registry login.

loginRegistryEnv.description: Environment variable name containing login registry override. Defaults to HELM_OCI_LOGIN_REGISTRY.

usernameEnv.description: Environment variable name containing registry username. Defaults to HELM_REGISTRY_USERNAME.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable name containing registry password/token. Defaults to HELM_REGISTRY_PASSWORD.

useDocker.description: Set to false to disable the Docker fallback when the host helm CLI is unavailable. Defaults to true.

dockerImage.description: Override the Helm container image used when host helm CLI is unavailable. Resolution order: HELM_CONTAINER_IMAGE env, this setting, then alpine/helm:3.17.3.

artifactSettingValue.description: Recursive value type for arbitrary custom artifact settings.

settingValue.description: Allowed primitive/array value types for generic settings maps.

outputsConfig.description: Output path contract. Paths default to subdirectories under the root output folder unless a plain relative path is provided, in which case the path is treated as repo-relative.
outputsConfig.markdownDescription:
Output path contract. See [Output Contract](docs/configuration/output-contract.md) and [CI Output Emission](docs/configuration/ci-output-emission.md).

- `emit`: master switch for runtime file emission.
- `root`: base folder for all generated outputs, defaulting to `artifacts`.
- `tests` / `analysis` / `security`: category-specific output trees whose values default under `outputs.root`.
- `packages`, `manifests`, `logs`, `temp`: common output locations that inherit from `outputs.root` unless you provide a plain relative path.

emit.description: When false, Rexo does not collect or write any output files (manifests, step file outputs). Well-known overlay commands also skip passing output path arguments to toolchain CLIs.
emit.markdownDescription: When `false`, Rexo does not collect or write runtime files such as manifests or step outputs. Default: `true`.

command.description: Defaults for command stdout and JSON output. CLI flags override these values.
command.markdownDescription: Defaults for command stdout and JSON output. CLI flags still override these values. `stdout` defaults to `true`, `json` defaults to `false`, and `jsonFile` is optional.

stdout.description: When true, command results are written to stdout by default.

json.description: When true, command results are rendered as JSON by default.

jsonFile.description: Optional default file path for machine-readable command results.

ci.markdownDescription: CI-native manifest emission settings. See [CI Output Emission](docs/configuration/ci-output-emission.md). `provider` defaults to `auto`, `github-actions.scope` defaults to `env`, `prefix` defaults to `REXO_`, `keyCasing` defaults to `upperSnake`, and `redact` defaults to `true`.

emit.description: When true, emit CI-native variables after command execution.

provider.description: CI provider selection. Use auto to detect from the runtime environment.

scope.description: GitHub Actions file target. Use env for $GITHUB_ENV, output for $GITHUB_OUTPUT, or state for $GITHUB_STATE.

prefix.description: Prefix applied to emitted variable names.

keyCasing.description: Key casing format for emitted variables.

scope.description: Emission scope controls which manifest fields are exported. Use a preset or a structured selector with include/exclude masks.

mode.description: Baseline scope to filter from. Defaults to safe unless include masks are present.

include.description: Masks that must match for a field to be emitted. Supports exact names, wildcard globs, and regex:... patterns.

exclude.description: Masks that remove matching fields after include filtering.

includeStepOutputs.description: When true, emit raw step outputs in addition to the safe summary payload.

emitEmptyValues.description: When true, emit variables even when values are empty or null.

redact.description: When true, redact sensitive values before emission.

failOnError.description: When true, CI emission errors fail the command.

root.description: Root folder for all generated outputs.
root.markdownDescription: Root folder for all generated outputs. Default: `artifacts`.

tests.markdownDescription: Paths for test-related outputs. Omitted values resolve beneath `outputs.root`.

results.description: Directory for test result files (e.g. TRX, JUnit XML).

reports.description: Directory for generated coverage reports (HTML, etc.).

analysis.markdownDescription: Paths for analysis-related outputs. Omitted values resolve beneath `outputs.root`.

security.markdownDescription: Paths for security audit outputs. Omitted values resolve beneath `outputs.root`.

audit.description: Full file path for the npm/security audit JSON output.

sarif.description: SARIF output directory for security findings.

packages.description: Directory for built artifact packages (NuGet, npm, Helm charts, etc.).
packages.markdownDescription: Directory for built artifact packages. Default: `~/packages` under `outputs.root`.

manifests.markdownDescription: Manifest output settings. Default path is `~/manifests`; `commandMode` defaults to `aggregate` (`single` is an alias); `commandDetail` defaults to `summary`.

path.description: Directory for command/runtime manifest files. Use ~/... to resolve relative to outputs.root; plain relative paths are repo-relative.
path.markdownDescription: Directory for command/runtime manifest files. `~/...` resolves under `outputs.root`; plain relative paths are repo-relative. Default: `~/manifests`.

commandMode.description: Command manifest file strategy. Use aggregate for one file containing all commands, perCommand for one file per command, or single as an alias for aggregate.
commandMode.markdownDescription: Command manifest file strategy. `aggregate` is the default; `single` is an alias for `aggregate`; `perCommand` writes one file per command.

commandDetail.description: Command manifest detail level. Use summary for concise output or verbose for full command result payload.
commandDetail.markdownDescription: Command manifest detail level. `summary` is the default; `verbose` includes the full `CommandResult` payload.

logs.markdownDescription: Directory for CI log files. Default: `~/logs`.

temp.description: Scratch directory for intermediate build artifacts.
temp.markdownDescription: Scratch directory for intermediate build artifacts. Default: `~/tmp`.

runtime.markdownDescription:
Cross-cutting runtime policy configuration for output, push, and command delegation. See [Runtime Configuration](docs/configuration/runtime.md).

- `dryRun`: simulate actions instead of mutating external systems.
- `push`: global push gate merged with per-artifact push rules.
- `commands`: global command execution policy such as default merge mode and max depth.

dryRun.description: Enables dry-run mode for the runtime. When true, external mutations are simulated instead of executed.
dryRun.markdownDescription: Enables dry-run mode for the runtime. When `true`, Rexo simulates actions instead of performing side effects where supported. Default: `false`.

push.description: Global push policy merged with per-artifact push overrides.
push.markdownDescription: Global push policy merged with per-artifact push overrides. See [Runtime Configuration](docs/configuration/runtime.md). `runtime.push.dryRun` can force push-related commands into simulation mode even when the global runtime flag is off.

commands.markdownDescription: Global command execution policy settings. `defaultMergeMode` is the fallback when a child command does not specify merge mode; `maxDepth` defaults to `5`.

defaultMergeMode.description: Fallback command collision behavior when a child command omits merge.mode. Applied before the built-in replace fallback.
defaultMergeMode.markdownDescription: Fallback command collision behavior when a child command omits `merge.mode` or legacy `merge`. Accepts the same values as command-level merge modes.

maxDepth.description: Default maximum delegated command call depth.
maxDepth.markdownDescription: Default maximum delegated command call depth. Default: `5`.

pushRules.markdownDescription:
Global push policy merged with per-artifact push overrides. See [Runtime Configuration](docs/configuration/runtime.md).

- `enabled`: global on/off switch for push operations.
- `noPushInPullRequest`: blocks pushes in pull-request CI contexts.
- `requireCleanWorkingTree`: blocks pushes when the git tree is dirty.
- `branches`: allowed branch patterns; empty means no branch restriction.
- `dryRun`: forces push into simulation mode without provider calls.

dryRun.description: Enables dry-run mode for push operations. This can be used to simulate pushes while leaving the global runtime mode unchanged.
dryRun.markdownDescription: Enables dry-run mode for push operations. When `true`, push-related commands simulate success without calling artifact providers. Default: `false`.

enabled.markdownDescription: Enables or disables push globally. Default: `true`.

noPushInPullRequest.description: Rejects push when CI context indicates a pull request build.
noPushInPullRequest.markdownDescription: Rejects push when CI context indicates a pull request build. Default: `false`.

requireCleanWorkingTree.description: Rejects push when the git working tree has uncommitted changes.
requireCleanWorkingTree.markdownDescription: Rejects push when the git working tree has uncommitted changes. Default: `false`.

branches.description: Allowed branch patterns for push. Empty means no branch restriction.
branches.markdownDescription: Allowed branch patterns for push. Empty means no branch restriction and the default is an empty allow-list.
